research_question: Does the optimisation engine find known optima, enforce constraints and budgets, and keep final candidates feasible under the trusted solver?
hypothesis: H5.1 L-BFGS/SQP/DE reach Rosenbrock f < 1e-4 within budget. H5.2 SQP recovers the QP KKT point (mu = 1). H5.3 BO beats DE/GA on Branin at 40 evaluations. H5.4 every final candidate is feasible under the trusted solver. H5.5 the robust optimum satisfies the 95% chance constraint where the deterministic optimum may not. H5.6 adjoint LSQ recovers alpha within 2 standard errors; the PINN estimate is less accurate.
dataset_description: synthetic observations for the inverse problem (noise sigma = 0.01)
